# Jugnu (jugnu.fun)

> Free, ad-free, privacy-first creative and learning studio for kids ages 4–8 (`https://www.jugnu.fun`) featuring a 3D Voxel block studio, multi-brush drawing & handwriting tracing board, custom printable A4 worksheets, child-safe brain games, and CBSE Class 1 Olympiad practice. Zero logins, zero ads, zero tracking cookies.

For complete details on all studios, games, topics, FAQs, and guides, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.jugnu.fun/llms-full.txt).

## Creative Studios & Printable Tools
- [3D Voxel Studio](https://www.jugnu.fun/voxel-studio): Interactive 3D candy-clay block builder with guided Build Together templates, symmetry mirror mode, paint/erase/fill tools, and local save/export.
- [Drawing Board & Tracing Worksheets](https://www.jugnu.fun/drawing-board): Four modes — Trace (4-line English, 2-line Hindi, math squares), Worksheet (6-row repeated sheets), Free Draw (13 brushes + temporary trace-image upload), and Gods Coloring Studio (12 illustrations). Exports JPG and PDF.
- [Printable Worksheets & Mistake Revision](https://www.jugnu.fun/learning-tools): Custom A4 printable tracing pack generator and automatic mistake-revision quiz builder.
- [Help a Seed Grow](https://www.jugnu.fun/explore/seed): Short guided nature and tracing activity on how seeds grow.

## Educational Kids Games
- [Games Arcade](https://www.jugnu.fun/games): Curated ad-free mini-games for young learners.
- [Sliding Picture Puzzle](https://www.jugnu.fun/games/sliding-puzzle): 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 tile puzzles across 12 children's illustrations plus **Custom Photo Upload** to play with any family picture.
- [Hanuman Run](https://www.jugnu.fun/games/hanuman-runner): Endless adventure runner with Classic and 3D clay artwork, Ram Coin collection, and keyboard/one-tap touch controls.

## Class 1 Olympiad & Subject Practice
- [Home](https://www.jugnu.fun/): Overview of Creative Studios, Games, Subject Catalog, and Practice/Exam modes.
- [English Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/english): 120 questions across Vocabulary, Grammar, Spelling, Reading Comprehension, Sentence Formation, Opposites, and Mock Papers.
- [Mathematics Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/mathematics): Numbers, shapes, addition, and word puzzles for Class 1.
- [Science Olympiad Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/science): 100 questions covering living things, plants, animals, the human body, and earth.
- [General Knowledge Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/general-knowledge): World facts, flags, festivals, seasons, and general awareness.
- [Logical Reasoning Practice](https://www.jugnu.fun/topics/logical-reasoning): Patterns, visual puzzles, sequences, and early critical thinking.

## Parent Guides, Updates & Trust
- [What's New](https://www.jugnu.fun/whats-new): Latest features, 3D Voxel Studio releases, and tool updates.
- [Parent Blog & Guides](https://www.jugnu.fun/blog): Practical guides on Maths Olympiad prep, 4-line handwriting, and healthy screen time.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/faq): Answers on tracing, iPad/Apple Pencil support, 3D Voxel Studio, local storage, and exports.
- [Parent's Guide](https://www.jugnu.fun/information/parent-guide): Tips for short, balanced learning and creative sessions.
- [About Jugnu](https://www.jugnu.fun/about): Core principles (Zero Data Collection, Instant Access, Client-Side Memory, Children's Book Design).
